Recorded reader is nonscripting/nonstyling, with zero source-hidden omissions or tokenizer issues. Current reader preserves divs but excludes scripts and arbitrary data-props/data-vue attributes; no unexpected text omission or code defect established.
Main's separate saved comparison produces identical live-text hash and 4726 bytes under document, main-content-v1 and main-content-v2. Focus selection is not this capture's cause.
JSON-LD hasPart declares the string False for .ld-paywall. This is partial/unverified source metadata, not established whole-page denial or proof of the empty mount's cause.

Decoded target bytes and hash agree with capture/result/manifest, and the source ends with closing body/html tags. No capture-truncation evidence; completeness of application content remains unproved.

# Manuals.plus category attempt — main review

The intended path was the public root to its literal Logitech category link.
This was a discovery step, not yet a model-manual request.

- Root: HTTP200,59,184 decoded bytes. Exact target discovery found one eligible
  Logitech link; native mousedown/mouseup/click dispatch occurred.
- Category: HTTP403,16,191 decoded bytes. Selected response headers include
  `cf-mitigated: challenge`. Native outcome is semantic-barrier, with provider
  Cloudflare and confirmed confidence specifically from that response header.
- Failure is policy-denied at native-click. No target extraction, manual content,
  model selection, download or success claim follows from the source click.
- Two GETs only. Observed starts14:11:53.192Z and14:11:55.195Z on September16,2026,
  separated by2.003 seconds. No retries, redirects, credentials or bypass attempt.
  Source document and native transport/child groups close; HOME/TMP stay empty.
- Category decoded-body SHA256:
  `7d04507d149aa14ff594669c7798769025dda98984604f9567aa8eaa9b1785bd`.

This is header/receipt-based barrier review, not inspection of manual content or
a claim about the barrier's cause. The saved source/403 pair replays the same
outcome, evidence and failure under kernel-denied networking. Human handoff is
required to continue this particular category path; other browser work is not
blocked. No alternate URL/client is tried to avoid the restriction.
